propositions: VOTER_ERROR marker is counted twice by observability probe because logger.error(line) and print(line, file=sys.stderr) both emit the line-start token, and configure_logging attaches a StreamHandler to both stdout paths that journald merges

Four sibling emitters (MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR, RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, LLM_TOKEN_USAGE) exhibit the same dual-emission construct, causing MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR to live-double and the others to latently double any future anchored consumer

Root cause activated by commit b0ac2544720 (c130-6a87-531e-4441) wiring configure_logging's stdout StreamHandler, which awakened the second line-start emission path in marker functions that already had unconditional stderr prints

Fix: keep unconditional print(line, file=sys.stderr) as the single line-start marker emission (fail-safe works in configured and unconfigured logging) and change logger copy to log record body without token prefix, preventing logger stream from matching probe anchor regex
